title: Only authorised numbers have access
body_md: At this point the source states in red that only authorised numbers can access Pro-finder.
prev_context: Before this stands the control of the alarm system by call.
change_reason: Extracted from the English source page itself, not translated from the German master, and cross-read against the German page 21: equivalent in substance and set as a note box in both versions. How the device recognises authorisation remains unstated here as well (DSC-017).
